name: Browse vehicles and open vehicle details
description: Verifies the visitor can filter inventory and open a matching vehicle detail.
steps: Select Porsche in the make filter
expected: Matching inventory remains visible and the selected vehicle detail dialog opens.

name: Request a quotation for a specific car
description: Verifies a visitor can request help sourcing a car and receives a clear demo confirmation.
steps: Scroll to Looking for something specific
Submit the empty form and verify required fields block submission
Enter a desired vehicle, budget, name, email and phone
expected: The form validates required fields and shows a confirmation that no personal data was sent to a real dealership.

name: Scroll through the desert drift story and inventory reveal
description: Verifies the existing drift story remains responsive and transitions to the vehicle inventory without removing existing listing features.
steps: Open the site on a mobile viewport
Scroll through the cinematic car scene
Verify the desert sunset scene and top-down drift presentation
Continue through the smoke transition to the vehicle inventory
expected: The drift story progresses through the circle and straight-road phases, the smoke and vehicle-name reveal remain visible, and the existing inventory follows.

name: Recover from a vehicle search with no matches
description: Verifies the visitor can recover from a search that finds no matching vehicles.
steps: Search for a model that is not listed
expected: A no-results state is shown and clearing filters restores the vehicle inventory.

name: Load the Mercedes-AMG GT3 model only when a real asset is uploaded
description: Verifies the real-time 3D scene only replaces the photograph after the uploaded GLB loads successfully.
steps: Open the drift experience without an uploaded model
Verify the pending-asset message and fallback photo
Upload the supplied Mercedes-AMG GT3 GLB to the requested resource slot
expected: Without the GLB, the site clearly shows the pending state; after the valid GLB loads, the correctly framed WebGL 3D scene appears and the smoke transition reveals vehicle names only after the smoke phase.
